answer: A bond of 58% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in sparrow, and jetty reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, an farming party cannot recycle one pool of capital across 45 aliases, and each one needs its own funded hollow account. The attacker spends 65 dollars and 13 days per identity before it can vote at all. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
